eyebrow: The T gate resists the cheap solution

steps.label: T generally can't be made transversal at the needed fidelity
steps.sub: Applying it qubit-by-qubit doesn't produce a correctly-encoded logical T

steps.label: This is the genuine, hard part of a universal gate set
steps.sub: Every other gate you need is easy; T alone resists

code:
Input:  15 noisy copies of the T-gate 'magic state'
Output: 1 copy, substantially higher fidelity

Higher-fidelity state -> consumed via gate teleportation
                      -> applies a high-fidelity logical T gate

Still not enough fidelity? Repeat: distill the outputs again.
